description: Recent signal metadata for a specified kind
sql:
SELECT id, kind, timestamp
      FROM signal_records
      WHERE kind = :kind
        AND timestamp >= :since_ms
      ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT :n
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: SEARCH signal_records USING COVERING INDEX signal_records_kind_timestamp (kind=? AND timestamp>?)
